Promptr Studio Pro 5.79

  • Two more Kling models. Kling 3 is the non-turbo Kling 3.0 in 720p, 1080p and 4K with an optional soundtrack and an end frame on every tier; its silent 720p clips cost less per second than Kling Turbo. Kling O3 brings the O3 family in 720p and 1080p with sound, start and end frames, and a reference mode that follows one reference video plus up to four character images. Kling Turbo and Kling O3 4K stay as they are.
  • Sound is a visible price decision. Kling 3 and Kling O3 show the Sound switch; with sound on, a second costs about a third more in 720p and 1080p, 4K is priced the same either way. The quote always shows the exact amount before you generate.

Promptr Studio Pro 5.78

  • Failed jobs now say what to do. When a provider blocks a prompt, the card says so and offers to edit the input instead of inviting a retry that would fail identically. Unreadable or oversized reference files, rejected settings, missing faces and provider outages each get their own explanation and their own next step.
  • Reference images are prepared for the provider. HEIC, TIFF and BMP files are converted to JPEG or PNG before upload, rotation and colours are corrected, and very large files are reduced. Files that already fit stay untouched, your originals are never changed, and an image with a mask keeps its exact dimensions.
  • Favourites show on the thumbnail again. The heart of a favourited asset stays visible in the gallery, including while a selection is active.
  • No duplicate audio charges. A paid audio request is no longer sent again automatically after a dropped connection. If the outcome is unclear, the card says so and asks you to check for a result first.

Promptr Studio Pro 5.77

  • Removed generations stay removed. A card removed from the gallery no longer reappears after the next generation. Removals are recorded next to the project manifest, so a second app or teammate working in the same project folder can no longer bring them back.
  • Current GPT Image prices. The quoted price now includes the prompt text tokens OpenAI bills, so estimate and charge match the real cost. Prices come from the catalog, no further update is needed.
